messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "patients can start Rybelsus up to 7 days after last injection"
set: ["patients can start Rybelsus up to 7 days after last injection", "patients can start Ozempic the day after their last dose of Rybelsus", "Rybelsus 7 mg", "7 days", "3 to 7 days", "if you choose a different weekly injection day start new schedule after at least 2 days have passed since last injection", "patients treated with Rybelsus 14 mg daily can be transitioned to Ozempic subcutaneous injection 0.5 mg once weekly", "Rybelsus", "after five days", "titration should proceed over 7 to 14 days", "throw away unused suspension 30 days after made up", "tablet can start to break apart quickly", "should not breastfeed during use or for 2 days after last dose", "requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose", "false-positive result can continue for several days after stopping", "increase dose to 7 mg once daily after 30 days on 3 mg dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
